en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, a sloping lawn with fences and rows of trees in the middle, and behind them a richly decorated Orthodox church with multiple onion domes and crosses. Surrounding the church are grand late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century apartment and villa buildings with eclectic and half‑timbered façades. A small signboard stands by the path near the right side of the image.
